description: Deterministic-machine trace (virtual milliseconds): the original's tie quirk. A generated RECS.DAT has 0 as its 7th score; a one-player game abandoned at once ends with 0 points, which passes EndGame's >= test but not EnterName's rank loop (<), so the rank is 8 and the new entry is written to HighScores[8], past the table, over the saved INT 9/INT 1C vectors (compared byte for byte; the layout is the same in both builds). The table itself is saved unchanged. The comparison stops before the Return key is released: that keyboard interrupt would call through the overwritten vector, whose effect depends on memory outside the program.

RECS.DAT.note: generated by this trace (not the shipped RECS.DAT): seven records of the game's format, a count byte then LongInt score + string[8] name each
